fields.statement: Ship-change conflict fix (change set 01M6WMCC): how should the run bring origin/main into a change set's branch? Today `rhiza ship rebase` (steps rebase, rebase-merge) and `ship check --settled` (wait steps, on a CONFLICTING PR) rebase and force-push with a lease, and only merge when the branch already holds a merge. / When the merge conflicts in code, a fixer agent step resolves it. Who pushes the fixer's merge commit to the PR? / If the fixer finds a real design clash (both sides change the same behaviour in incompatible ways), what happens? / How many conflict-fix cycles may one ship-change run make before it fails?
